12 meals feed 18 people, so each meal feeds 1.5 people. To feed 12 people, they need 12 / 1.5 = 8 meals.

Both solutions are wrong: A gets 6 and B gets 9. Neither is correct, but I have to pick one.

Solution A makes an error in setting up the proportion (it treats the meal as feeding 3/2 people but then computes x = 6 with faulty logic). Solution B sets up its proportion incorrectly (12/x = 2/3 gives x = 18, and it then wrongly divides by 2 to get 9).

Checking how close each is to 8: A is off by 2, B is off by 1. B is closer, but neither is correct, so this is a judgment call between two wrong answers.

WINNER: B
